video_title: Did Hitler Escape? The Theories, the Evidence, and Why They Break
video_description: On April 30, 1945, Adolf Hitler died in a bunker beneath Berlin. Within weeks, rumors said he had escaped. We look at the most famous survival theories, from U-boats landing in Argentina to CIA files and a skull fragment that turned out to be a woman's, and at the dental records, witnesses, and forensic studies that explain why the evidence points to his death in 1945.
